Here are four more places for Porto that match your interests, plus a new section for them.

## Live music

- **Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club** – Live sets Thursday to Saturday from 22:00, free entry most nights. [Map](https://maps.google.com/?cid=555)
- **Casa da Musica** – Rem Koolhaas concert hall, worth it for the building alone. Tickets from €12. 4.7 stars (28,410 reviews)

## Coffee

- **Fabrica Coffee Roasters** – Filter-focused, opens 08:00, quiet enough to work in.

### Backups

- **Mesa 325** – Good enough coffee, better cake.
